title: Senior Manager – Operations
description:
Yolojet Internet Services Pvt. Ltd.

Senior Manager – Operations

* Skills: PTL / B2B / Courier operations, negotiations and onboarding
* Location: Gurgaon, Sector 65
* Preferred experience: 5-7 years

Compensation: INR 6-8 lakhs per annum

About the role

Lead Yolojet's operations team and own reliable execution across PTL, B2B, courier and appointment-based

deliveries. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role combining team leadership, vendor management, fast

escalation resolution and customer retention. You will build SOP-led ways of working, improve service

performance and help grow business from existing customers through dependable operations.

Key responsibilities

1. Lead the team and build SOP discipline

* Lead a team of 7-9 people, currently 4 customer Key Account Managers (KAMs) and 3 operations

executives, with team size varying by business requirements. Coach the team, set clear responsibilities

and daily priorities, and review performance regularly.

* Create and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation paths and checklists. Train the

team, check adherence and build accountability for shipment follow-ups, customer updates and issue

closure. Fix recurring gaps rather than relying on individual follow-ups.

2. Own customer retention and account growth

* Take operational ownership of customers after the sales handover. Understand service requirements,

maintain proactive communication and build strong working relationships with customer teams and

leadership.

* Lead service recovery for at-risk accounts, address repeat complaints and follow through on corrective

actions. Work with sales to retain customers and expand business within existing accounts through

consistent service.

3. Manage vendor relationships and commercials

* Identify, onboard and manage PTL and courier vendors. Negotiate competitive pricing and service terms,

review performance against agreed SLAs and address service gaps with local, regional and senior vendor

teams.

* Use established industry relationships to manage daily escalations and secure practical support from

vendors such as Gati, Delhivery, Ekart, V-Xpress, Rivigo and Safe express etc.

4. Lead daily execution and escalation resolution

* Oversee first-mile, mid-mile and last-mile execution, from pickup through delivery confirmation. Act as

the senior escalation point for delayed pickups, transit delays, failed deliveries and other shipment issues;

drive urgent cases to closure with timely customer updates.

* Own appointment-based deliveries, including Quick Commerce and Modern Trade warehouse

requirements. Manage slot coordination, documentation and e-way bill compliance, and take timely action

to prevent missed appointments.

Yolojet Internet Services Pvt. Ltd. Senior Manager - Operations | 2

5. Build reliable backup transport options

* Develop a network of local and regional transporters and small-truck owners across major cities. Arrange

suitable backup vehicles when courier services fail, coordinating rates, pickup, delivery and customer

communication.

6. Improve systems, reporting and service performance

* Become proficient in the internal operations portal and ensure accurate, timely data and team adoption.

Identify workflow gaps and suggest practical portal improvements and enhancements to the technology

team.

* Use Excel/Google Sheets and operational reports to track team and vendor performance, delivery

reliability, appointment adherence, escalation closure, customer retention and costs. Identify root causes

and drive corrective action.

7. Control vendor billing and claims

* Check vendor and courier invoices for discrepancies against agreed rates, shipments and service terms,

and ensure errors are raised and corrected before payment.

* Ensure damage and shortage reconciliation and credit notes are obtained from couriers in a timely manner.

Make this a standard part of the team's SOP culture, with clear ownership, follow-up and closure tracking.

Non-Negotiable Experience and capabilities

* Mandatory 4-7 years of relevant experience, with extensive hands-on PTL operations experience at

courier/logistics companies or aggregators.

* Strong practical knowledge of PTL, B2B, courier and appointment-based delivery operations, including

day-to-day issue resolution.

* Proven team management skills: coaching people, setting clear expectations, enforcing SOPs and

improving accountability and execution.

* Established relationships with PTL/courier vendors, plus a useful network of local and regional

transporters and vehicle owners.

* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with the confidence to engage courier leadership

and customer leadership directly.

* A track record of resolving customer escalations, recovering service issues and helping retain or grow

existing customer accounts.

* Comfort with technology, internal portals and Excel/Google Sheets; able to turn operational data and

frontline feedback into clear improvement actions.

What we value

High ownership, clear communication and calm judgment under pressure. Someone who stays close to daily

operations, supports the team and closes the loop with customers and vendors, while building processes that

prevent the same problems from repeating.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager
company: Pulse Magnetic and Power Electronics Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**PRODUCTION MANAGER**

**Pulse Magnetic and Power Electronics Pvt. Ltd. (PMPE)**

**Department**

Production / Manufacturing

**Employment Type**

Full-Time

**Location**

Plot No. 49, Pulse Magnetic and Power Electronics Pvt. Ltd., Udyog Vihar, Phase-1, Industrial Area, Dundahera, Gurugram, Haryana – 122016

**Experience**

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience

**COMPANY PROFILE**

Pulse Magnetic and Power Electronics Pvt. Ltd. (PMPE) is an engineering and manufacturing company based in Gurugram, Haryana. The company manufactures transformers, inductors, chokes and other magnetic components for industrial and electronic applications. Production activities include winding, assembly, cleaning, finishing, inspection, testing and packing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

PMPE is looking for an experienced Production Manager to lead day-to-day manufacturing operations for transformers, inductors, chokes and other magnetic components. The role is responsible for production planning, team supervision, delivery schedules, product quality, resource utilisation and safe, efficient shop-floor operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Plan daily and weekly production schedules based on customer orders, delivery commitments, available capacity, manpower and material availability.

· Oversee shop-floor activities including winding, assembly, varnishing/impregnation, finishing, inspection, testing and packing, as applicable to each product.

· Allocate jobs and resources, supervise production operators and helpers, and monitor output, productivity, attendance and work discipline.

· Ensure products are manufactured according to approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality requirements; coordinate with the Quality team on inspections and defects.

· Track daily production targets, work-in-progress, rejections, rework and delays; maintain accurate production records and report deviations promptly.

· Coordinate with Stores, Purchase, Quality, Engineering and Dispatch teams to ensure material readiness, resolve production issues and meet delivery commitments.

· Monitor material consumption, yield, scrap and wastage; promote efficient use of manpower, materials, tools and equipment.

· Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures, safety rules, PPE requirements, chemical-handling procedures, fire safety and workplace organisation (5S).

· Identify bottlenecks and implement practical improvements to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, improve quality and control manufacturing costs.

· Coordinate preventive maintenance of production machines, tools and equipment with the concerned team, and promptly address breakdowns affecting output.

· Train and guide team members on work methods, quality expectations, safe practices and process changes; identify skill gaps and training needs.

· Investigate production non-conformities, recurring defects and customer complaints with the relevant teams, and follow through on corrective and preventive actions.

· Prepare production status updates for management and support internal/customer audits and other manufacturing-related tasks as required.

**REQUIREMENTS**

· Degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Production Engineering or a related discipline.

· At least 5 years of relevant production or manufacturing experience; experience with transformers, inductors, chokes or electrical/electronic products will be an advantage.

· Experience in production planning, shop-floor supervision, manpower allocation and meeting delivery schedules.

· Ability to understand engineering drawings, technical specifications, process instructions and quality requirements.

· Good coordination, communication, problem-solving and team-leadership skills, with a practical and disciplined approach.

· Working knowledge of production reports, Excel or ERP systems; familiarity with quality systems, 5S and root-cause analysis is preferred.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

· Salary: 50,000 ₹-60,000₹ initial salary

· Opportunity to lead and improve production operations in an engineering manufacturing environment.

· Paid leave and statutory benefits, as applicable.

· Opportunity to work with transformers, inductors, chokes and other magnetic components.

· A safe, professional and supportive working environment.

**COMPENSATION & WORK DETAILS**

· Working Hours: 8:30 am to 5:30 pm

· Weekly Off: Sunday

· Joining: Immediate

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested candidates may contact PMPE or send their details to:

**anu@pmpe.ind.in | omansh@pmpe.ind.in**

***Join our team and grow with us!***

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* पेमेंट वाली छुट्टियाँ
* प्रॉविडेंट फ़ंड

description:
**About Zippee:**

* Zippee is building India’s #1 Quick Commerce Logistics for consumer brands.
* Brands connect their online store to Zippee in just a few clicks & can kickstart 30-Min Delivery/120-Min/Same-Day Delivery for customers through our dark store network across India.
* Our team is ex. Retention Science, oracle SCM, zomato, & from institutions like Hindu College, BITS Pilani, and the University of Southern California.
* Backed by VCs & founders of India's biggest unicorns, including Ashneer Grover (BharatPe), Kunal Shah (CRED), Peyush Bansal (Lenskart), and Prashant Pitti (easemytrip).

**Job Description:**

* We're looking for a **Senior Operations Manager - Warehouse to manage end-to-end Operations for our Warehouses and FCs across India.**
* **Incredible opportunity to drive meaningful impact** in Operations at a high-growth quick commerce startup.
* This is a high-pressure, zero-handholding, unstructured environment, where no task is beneath you if it moves the mission forward. We move fast, we set a high bar, and we’re not for everyone.

* Forecast manpower requirements and build staffing models across all warehouse functions based on order volumes, SKU mix, and peak demand.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's in Business, Operations, or Supply Chain from a top institution; MBA highly preferred.
* 6–15 years in WH Management or supply chain, with hands-on experience in process design, SLA adherence, and supply chain costs.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Sheets and BI dashboards; proven ability to manage teams and stakeholders independently.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and willingness to travel for ground-level execution.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure startup environment and willingness to travel to execute projects on the ground.
* High ownership mindset with the drive to take initiatives from concept to execution.

**What you'll get:**

* Be part of a tight-knit rocket ship passionate about empowering consumer brands in the quick commerce era.
* Steep learning and growth curve.
* Annual company retreat.

title: Operations Director
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

Monks is seeking an experienced Operations Director to lead the Delhi-based team delivering rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. This senior, client-facing role will oversee day-to-day operations across multiple shifts, ensuring work is properly prioritized, staffed, trafficked, reviewed and delivered.

The ideal candidate is a process-oriented operational leader who can bring structure to a complex, fast-moving environment. You will manage regional capacity and team performance, partner closely with the US-based Monks leadership team and serve as a senior point of contact for client stakeholders.

An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential. All briefs, client communications and creative deliverables will be in English.

### **In This Role, You Will**

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Delhi-based creative team across multiple shifts and workstreams.
* Serve as a senior regional contact for client stakeholders and Monks leadership.
* Oversee intake, prioritization, staffing, production, review, approval and final delivery.
* Translate incoming demand into clear capacity plans, assignments, timelines and escalation paths.
* Manage and support producers or project managers responsible for individual shifts and deliverables.
* Maintain visibility across active work, team capacity, deadlines, risks, dependencies and approvals.
* Establish clear operating standards across shifts, including intake, documentation, QA, handoffs and delivery.
* Ensure cross-shift handoffs include current status, decisions, open questions, source files and next actions.
* Use sound judgment to determine when work should continue within a shift and when a regional handoff will improve speed.
* Partner closely with US-based Monks leadership to align priorities, processes, staffing and client communications.
* Build productive client relationships and provide clear recommendations when priorities, timing or capacity conflict.
* Consolidate feedback, resolve operational ambiguity and escalate only when client direction or approval is genuinely required.
* Maintain senior oversight of producer-level QA, version control, asset packaging and delivery requirements.
* Monitor service levels and operational performance, identifying recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop reporting around volume, turnaround times, capacity, workflow health and team performance.
* Support team onboarding, training and retention of program-specific knowledge.
* Partner with creative, editorial and technical leaders to maintain quality without slowing delivery.
* Work with AI and creative technology specialists to improve workflows, automation and production efficiency.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

### **Experience You Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in creative operations, production, program management or project management within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading large or multi-shift creative production teams.
* Strong client-facing experience and confidence communicating with senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing rapid-turn digital, web, editorial, design and motion deliverables.
* Proven ability to build scalable processes and maintain operational consistency across teams and shifts.
* Strong capacity-planning, resource-management, trafficking and delivery-management skills.
* Experience leading and developing producers, project managers or other operational team members.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of creative and technical QA.
* Ability to operate autonomously, make informed decisions and navigate ambiguity.
* Experience partnering across regions, time zones and organizational functions.
* Ability to distinguish critical issues from lower-priority feedback and provide practical resolution paths.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required, as all briefs, client communications and creative deliverables will be in English.
* Clear executive communication, documentation and presentation skills.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.
* Ability to support a nontraditional operating model and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.

### **Working Model**

This is a hybrid leadership role supporting a global, shift-based production model. The Operations Director will oversee teams working across early morning, evening, overnight and other nontraditional schedules. The role requires sufficient flexibility to maintain leadership coverage across shifts, support planned weekend and holiday rotations and respond to urgent operational priorities. Schedules and coverage expectations will be established in advance wherever possible.  
#LI-PP1  
#LI-REMOTE

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek's first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show's inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group's 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.

This team's first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:

* Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure
* Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible
* Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

### **Who We Are**

GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

### **Responsibilities**

* Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security
* Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one
* Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders
* Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem
* Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership
* Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward
* Build and lead an inclusive, high-performing global team by setting clear goals and operating rhythms; coaching and developing talent through regular, candid feedback and career conversations; monitoring team health and engagement; recognizing strong performance and addressing performance concerns early and fairly; and communicating change early with clarity and context

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years of experience in security operations, security engineering, or a related technical discipline, including at least 5 years in a people-leadership role
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Direct, hands-on experience in at least one of: vulnerability management, security automation or workflow tooling, or enterprise security operations
* A track record of hiring and ramping a technical team quickly while holding the line on quality and culture
* Experience operating successfully in a matrix structure — with the judgment to manage functional dotted-line relationships without losing ownership of your own team
* Comfort with a mandate that will evolve as the team matures — you're building this job as much as filling it
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills across geographies and time zones spanning the US, EMEA, and India

*Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.*

### **Nice to Haves**

* Background specifically in vulnerability management platforms, security orchestration/automation (SOAR) tooling, or enterprise security operations at scale
* Prior experience in a matrix organization with international, distributed reporting lines

### **Success in This Role Means**

* The India team is fully staffed and operating to MongoDB's standards for quality, pace, and culture
* Ability to step into direct delivery level accountability vs. extending capabilities of other teams once the initial team build phase is complete
* The India GSO team has moved from a build-phase support function to owning clear, accountable delivery in vulnerability management, workflow automation, and enterprise security

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

* Broad cross\-functional exposure to Safety, Operations, Ground Operations, and external stakeholders.

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Retail Operations Manager
description:
About KSKT \& Kaze Living

KSKT AgroMart (Kisaan Se Kitchen Tak) is a technology and supply\-chain venture delivering naturally grown,

chemical\-free agro\-produce directly from trusted farms \- at fair prices for consumers and fair returns for farmers

practising Good Agricultural Practices.

Kaze Living is KSKT's premium gourmet grocery marketplace \- bringing fresh produce, artisan bakery, clean\-

label snacks, functional beverages, wellness essentials, and curated lifestyle products to discerning Delhi NCR

households. Together, KSKT and Kaze Living are building a modern retail ecosystem that combines quality,

transparency, and convenience across online and offline channels. www.ksktagromart.com

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Retail Operations Manager to drive day\-to\-day store operations and omnichannel executionacross our retail network. Based at the Gurgaon HO, this role requires frequent travel to stores and the mother DC to ensure smooth, consistent, and efficient operations on the ground.You will own the operational and P\&L performance of stores, lead store teams, and act as the key coordination link between stores and the central DC.

**Key Responsibilities**

Retail \& Store Operations

* Own end\-to\-end store operations across the network \- opening/closing procedures, stock availability, store hygiene, and operational compliance.
* Drive standardization of SOPs across stores and ensure consistent execution on the ground.
* Conduct regular store visits/audits to identify gaps and drive corrective action.
* Troubleshoot day\-to\-day operational issues and escalate/resolve as needed.

Omnichannel Operations

* Manage omnichannel fulfilment from stores (online orders, click\-and\-collect, quick\-commerce/last\-mile integrations as applicable).
* Ensure store\-level readiness (systems, inventory accuracy, packing/dispatch processes) to support online order fulfilment.
* Work with tech/ops teams to resolve omnichannel order and inventory sync issues.

P\&L \& Business Ownership

* Own the P\&L of assigned stores \- driving revenue, controlling costs (shrinkage, wastage, manpower,utilities), and improving store profitability.
* Track and review store\-level performance metrics (sales, footfall, conversion, basket size, wastage) and drive improvement plans.
* Plan and monitor budgets for store operating expenses.

Team Handling

* Lead, mentor and manage store managers and store teams across the network.
* Drive hiring, training, performance management, and retention of store\-level staff.
* Build a strong, accountable store operations culture with clear ownership at each level.

Coordination with Mother DC

* Act as the primary coordination point between stores and the mother DC for stock replenishment, indenting, and fill\-rate management.
* Work closely with the DC team to resolve supply gaps, damages/returns, and delivery scheduling issues.
* Improve store\-DC processes to reduce stock\-outs and improve inventory turnaround.

What We Are Looking For

* 4\-6 years of experience in retail operations, store operations, or omnichannel retail, ideally in a multi\-store environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning store\-level P\&L and driving profitability.
* Strong team handling and people management experience across front\-line and supervisory staff.
* Comfort with frequent travel between HO, stores, and the DC.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and comfort operating in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets for tracking performance and inventory.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work across stores, DC, and HO teams.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Production Executive / Assistant Production Manager
description:
Assistant Production Manager / Production Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Industry:** Packaged Foods / FMCG Manufacturing

We are looking for a hands\-on production professional with relevant experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, cereals, snacks or similar food manufacturing**.

This role is not just for production supervision. The person should be capable of gradually taking ownership of **production planning, manpower, output, wastage, process control and daily factory execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and execute **daily and weekly production plans** based on orders, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Manage shop\-floor production across **mixing, dough preparation, forming, baking, cooling and packing** operations.
* Ensure achievement of **planned output, productivity and dispatch commitments**.
* Allocate manpower effectively across production lines and shifts.
* Monitor and control **yield, wastage, rework, breakage and process losses**.
* Track **plan vs actual production** and identify reasons for shortfalls.
* Monitor machine downtime, changeovers and production bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with **QC, Stores, Maintenance, Packing and Dispatch** teams for smooth production.
* Ensure availability of raw materials and packaging materials as per the production plan.
* Maintain process consistency for products such as **cookies, biscuits, rusk, cereals and related products**.
* Troubleshoot issues relating to **dough consistency, mixing, baking, colour, texture, moisture, crispness, breakage and product variation**.
* Support **new\-product trials and scale\-up from trial batches to commercial production**.
* Maintain proper batch records, production records, process parameters and shift handovers.
* Ensure compliance with factory hygiene, food\-safety, sanitation and production SOPs.
* Coordinate basic preventive maintenance and escalate machine issues on time.
* Prepare and maintain a simple **daily/weekly production MIS** covering:
* Production plan vs actual
* Output
* Wastage/yield
* Downtime
* Manpower
* Rework
* Key production issues
* Train and develop supervisors/operators so production does not depend on one individual.
* Be capable of independently managing routine production operations in the absence of the senior production head.

Candidate Profile

* **8–10 years** of relevant experience in food manufacturing.
* Strong preference for experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, rusk, cereals, snacks or similar dry\-food products**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **mixing, forming, baking, cooling and packing processes**.
* Understanding of food\-production variables such as **temperature, time, moisture, dough consistency, formulation variation and process control**.
* Experience managing production workers and shop\-floor manpower.
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on manufacturing environment.
* Ability to analyse production problems rather than merely escalate them.
* Working knowledge of food hygiene, GMP and basic food\-safety systems.
* Ability to maintain production records and MIS.
* Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech / B.Sc / Diploma in:  
**Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy/Food Processing,** or relevant manufcturing qualification.

Strong practical food\-production experience can compensate for formal qualification.

What We Will Evaluate in the Interview

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Production volume and number of workers previously handled.
* Examples of reducing wastage or improving yield.
* How they handle production shortfalls and machine downtime.
* How they plan manpower across multiple SKUs.
* Troubleshooting of biscuit/cookie/bakery production problems.
* Production MIS and KPIs they have personally managed.
* Examples of new\-product commercial scale\-up.
* How they would independently run production if their reporting manager were absent.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Do you have experience in formulating new products?
* Your current CTC (will be verified)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:
